description: This Java class 'ClientCollateralManagementRepositoryWrapper' acts as a service layer wrapper around repository operations related to client collateral management, including retrieving, updating, deleting, and saving collateral data associated with clients and loan products.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagementRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service class that provides methods to manage client collateral data, serving as a wrapper around underlying repository calls.

methods.name: getCollateralsPerClient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collateral management entities associated with a specific client.

methods.name: getClientCollateralData
methods.description: Fetches collateral data for a client, filtered by loan product if provided, and computes total collateral value.

methods.name: getCollateral
methods.description: Fetches a specific collateral management entity by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: updateClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Updates and persists a client collateral management entity.

methods.name: deleteClientCollateralProduct
methods.description: Deletes a collateral management entity by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a client collateral management entity.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Persists and immediately flushes changes of a client collateral management entity.
